contest.name: RAC Canada Day Contest
contest.description: RAC Canada Day Contest — held on Canada Day (July 1), 0000Z–2359Z (24 hours). CW and phone on 160/80/40/20/15/10/6/2 meters — no digital, no repeater QSOs. Canadian stations send RST + 2-letter province/territory abbreviation; VE0 maritime mobile and non-Canadian stations send RST + serial number. Work each station once per band per mode. QSO points: 20 per QSO with a RAC official station (VA2RAC, VA3RAC, VE1RAC, VE3RHQ, VE4RAC, VE5RAC, VE6RAC, VE7RAC, VE8RAC, VE9RAC, VO1RAC, VO2RAC, VY0RAC, VY1RAC, VY2RAC); 10 per QSO with a Canadian (or VE0) station; 2 per QSO with a non-Canadian station. Multipliers are Canada's 10 provinces and 3 territories (13 total), each counted once per band per mode. Final score = (sum of QSO points across all bands) × (sum of multipliers across all bands). Note: The rule grants a phantom multiplier of 1 to operators who fail to work any Canadian station — this app does not auto-apply that fallback (the score will simply be zero in that edge case). Cabrillo CONTEST tag: RAC-CANADA-DAY

userPrompts.question: Enter your exchange. Canadian stations: 2-letter province/territory (e.g. ON, BC, NS). VE0 and non-Canadian: leave blank (CLX will send a serial number).
userPrompts.description: Province/territory abbreviation (NS, QC, ON, MB, SK, AB, BC, NT, NB, NL, NU, YT, PE) for Canadian stations. VE0 maritime mobile and non-Canadian stations send a serial number — leave this field blank.

sent.name: EXCHs
sent.description: Province/territory for Canadian stations; serial number for VE0 and non-Canadian stations

received.name: EXCHr
received.description: Province/territory from Canadian stations; serial number from VE0 and non-Canadian stations

multipliers.description: 13 Canadian provinces/territories, each counted once per band per mode. Maximum 13 × 8 bands × 2 modes = 208 multiplier credits if every province is worked on every band/mode combination. Non-Canadian and VE0 contacts are points-only — they are not multipliers.

dupeChecking.description: Work each station once per band per mode. CW and SSB count separately on each of the 8 bands. CW contacts must not be made in the conventional phone sub-bands and vice versa. No repeater QSOs.

callHistory.description: Save received exchange (province/territory or serial) for future lookups

exchangeValidation.description: Exchange should be a 2-letter Canadian province/territory abbreviation (NS, QC, ON, MB, SK, AB, BC, NT, NB, NL, NU, YT, PE) from Canadian stations, or a serial number from VE0/non-Canadian stations.
